# Dictionary on Click

> A Firefox and Chrome extension that shows a definition bubble when you double-click a word.

Google has stated that llms.txt does not affect ranking or AI Overviews.

## Site

- Home: https://dictionary-on-click.bishwodahal.com
- How it works: https://dictionary-on-click.bishwodahal.com/how-it-works
- Features: https://dictionary-on-click.bishwodahal.com/features
- Privacy: https://dictionary-on-click.bishwodahal.com/privacy
- Install: https://dictionary-on-click.bishwodahal.com/install
- About: https://dictionary-on-click.bishwodahal.com/about

## Product

- Firefox: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/dictionary-on-click/
- Chrome: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/dictionary-on-click/hmjpafbglgihbbfamlljmcempfhfchjm
